# Bounded centers without changing the log-det barrier: a precision refinement

2026-10-28. ROOT CONSTRUCTION CANDIDATE, independent review pending. This changes the CENTER update domain of the received small-loss learner, not its source interface or target. It addresses the adverse pilot's conservative O(N)-bit precision bill, not its flat N512 learning or general-decoder control costs. The received source and all pilot evidence remain unchanged.

## 1. Domain and comparator

Use the received Pauli affine coordinates C(theta), k=2d, D=3d^2, Tr(E_a E_b)=k delta_ab and C0=I_k/k. Keep the ORIGINAL regularizer phi(theta)=-log det C(theta), not -log det(C-mu I). Keep eta=gamma/(64D^2), zeta=epsilon/16, delta=eta epsilon/64, and the same private terminal or separately justified service interface. This changed learner induces its OWN actual occupation law; the same comparator definition/source-cap form does not mean numerical identity with the earlier learner’s R_N.

Restrict only CENTER updates to

    K_zeta={C=zeta C0+(1-zeta)Z: Z>=0,Tr_out Z=I_d/d},
    mu=zeta/k.

Thus every center has C>=mu I. The received comparator C_*=(1-zeta)C_D+zeta C0 ALREADY belongs to this domain; its divergence and additive zeta debit are unchanged. No source-noise/gauge eigenvalue floor is introduced.

At a center use the same exact rational whitening certificate (1/2)I<=V^T H V<=I, exact inverse dual, and played actions theta +/- V e_i/2. These actions need NOT belong to K_zeta; they belong to the original physical CPTP body and have C_play>=C_center/2>=mu I/2 by the Dikin bound. Their mean is the center, and the same acquired-bit unbiasedness and small-loss second moment hold. Confusing the center constraint with the played-action domain would destroy the argument.

## 2. Constrained mirror step

For each acquired g solve, over K_zeta,

    f_t(theta)=eta <g,theta>+B_phi(theta,theta_t).

The exact minimizer theta^+ satisfies a variational inequality, NOT zero tangent gradient. For any feasible comparator u,

    <grad f_t(theta^+),theta^+-u> <=0.

Normal-cone terms have the favorable sign. Taking u=theta_t, the standard self-concordant monotonicity inequality gives, with r=||theta^+-theta_t||_(H_t) and a=eta||g||_(H_t^-1),

    r^2/(1+r) <= a r, hence r<=a/(1-a).

The received deterministic estimate ||g||_(H_t^-1)<=2sqrt(2)D and eta above give a<1/16, hence r<1/15. This remains v

# Independent audit: bounded centers, original log-det, and finite precision

28 October 2026. Reviewer: `producer-workspace/review_bounded_center_precision`.

**PASS / receive as a finite-precision refinement of the construction theorem, not a learning-performance improvement.** Reviewed final candidate SHA-256: `35efeef37e8ae0ed38b0b8d6a049cd98c15c8143b81e79565921fdfdf1333f4c`. The intermediate clarification version was `ab4b0c6e17c3595486fcfe4550d80f865703629a3a7d76e9bbb9226d2bfb138b`, preserved as `ordinary_prequential_bounded_center_precision_20261028_pre_repair_symbol.md`; its only subsequent change distinguished repair rho from learner delta. The original submitted version was `cd891307be95358ee5102394c259c2c30717813d084e7d75d03f2f6ff04e2ef5`, preserved as `ordinary_prequential_bounded_center_precision_20261028_initial.md`. The received small-loss source remains SHA `6edb6a3af1118947c1a864113a24d77eef437386eafb7d8694a4aa651dc8d1dc`.

No unresolved load-bearing mathematical objection remains. The original proposal survived review; the owner clarified its changed occupation law, unnormalized repair convention, fixed post-repair denominator family, and slack in the dual acceptance threshold. These are important implementation/scope clarifications, not a changed learning rate or claimed positive pilot result. This auditor did not edit the candidate, base theorem, or pilot files.

## 1. The constraint and the actual played domain

The new center set is precisely the set of normalized TP Choi matrices satisfying `C>=mu I`, because `mu=zeta/k` and `Z=(C-mu I)/(1-zeta)` then has partial trace `I_d/d`. The old shrunk comparator `(1-zeta)C_D+zeta C0` is already in this set. No extra comparator debit is needed.

The regularizer is the original `phi=-log det C`, smooth even at the **center-domain** boundary. It is not `-log det(C-mu I)`. The center constraint need not contain the Dikin plays. The exact whitening certificate implies `Cplay>=C/2>=mu I/2`, so they remain physically TP/positive in the original Choi set. Their two-sign average is exactly C. The acquired-bit unbiasedness, inverse-dual identity and loss-weighted variance proof are therefore unchanged.
